title: Unbounded degreewise open adjunctions and actual site-comparison counits
statement:
Let $R$ be a finite commutative ring and $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ an open immersion of arbitrary schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-open-immersion]. On the small etale and pro-etale sites use ordinary constant-$R$ module sheaves and their unbounded derived categories $D(T_t,R)$, $t=e,p$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write $C_T=\nu_T^*$ for exact site comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], $J^e=Dj_!^{et}$ and $J^p=Dj_!^{pro}$ for the functors induced degreewise by the sheafified extension-by-zero presheaves [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero, def-weil-extension-by-zero], and $U^t=j_t^*$ for exact restriction [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image].
The degreewise sheaf units and evaluation counits define actual adjunctions $J^t\dashv U^t$ on complexes, homotopy categories and unbounded derived categories. Their counits $v^t:J^tU^t\to1$ are induced by $s\mapsto s$ on every extension summand, and by the zero map if there is no factorization through $U$; their triangle identities are the localized degreewise triangle identities. Let $e:C_XJ^e\xrightarrow{\sim}J^pC_U$ be the specified canonical open site comparison [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison], and $r:C_UU^e\xrightarrow{\sim}U^pC_X$ the canonical restriction comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback], both applied degreewise and localized. If $\eta^t:1\to U^tJ^t$ denotes the actual unit, then
$$U^p(e_F)\circ r_{J^eF}\circ C_U(\eta_F^e)=\eta^p_{C_UF}$$
for every $F\in D(U_e,R)$, and
$$v^p_{C_XH}\circ J^p(r_H)\circ e_{U^eH}=C_X(v^e_H)$$
for every $H\in D(X_e,R)$. In particular these equations refer to the actual evaluation adjunctions, and hold for unbounded complexes, without a constructibility or Tor-amplitude assumption. Whenever these functors restrict to full subcategories on which $C_U,C_X$ are equivalences, the second equation identifies the actual pro-etale adjunction with the transported etale adjunction, including its counit. For the identity-proper-factor compactification of $j$, on the bounded-below etale inputs on which the fixed compact-support site comparison [def-sp-fixed-compact-support-comparison] is defined, it is the restriction of $e$ in the orientation $C_XJ^e\to J^pC_U$ (equivalently its inverse in the opposite orientation). Thus $e$ on the unbounded derived category extends that fixed bounded-below comparison.

proof.text: Use the existing specified etale and pro-etale sheaf extension/restriction adjunctions, with their existing exactness instances. The unbounded adjunctions in this module are exactly their mapDerivedCategoryAdjunction constructions, not newly selected adjunctions. The comparison functors are the existing exact site-comparison pullbacks.

Apply the sheaf unit normalization and cancel the extension comparison to write it in mate form. The proved source-library Adjunction.mapDerivedCategoryAdjunction_mate transports it to the specified derived adjunctions and mapDerivedCategorySquareIso comparisons. This theorem applies the exact-functor factorizations and localization uniqueness to the termwise adjunction. Cancel the inverse extension comparison to obtain the unit equation on all unbounded objects.

Expand each Hom bijection as its unit followed by the right functor applied to the map. Substitute the derived mate equation and use naturality of the restriction comparison at f. For the counit equation, cancel the inverse extension comparison and use injectivity of the pro-etale Hom bijection; specialize the Hom equation to the etale counit. Unit naturality and both right triangle identities identify the resulting maps. These are purely formal calculations in the specified adjunctions.

For the identity morphism use the source-library lowerStarComparisonUpperStarBaseChange_app_id and rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange_id. They identify the specified bounded-below direct-image mate with the two canonical derived identity isomorphisms. Their compatibility with inclusion into the unbounded derived category follows by uniqueness of right derived natural transformations: after the unit, both paths are the image of the underived identity comparison. On the etale side the canonical exact-derived identity isomorphism has this normalization by mapDerivedCategoryIdIso_factorsh and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fach; on the pro-etale side use rightDerivedFunctorNatTrans_app and rightDerivedFunctorIdIso_fac_app. Expanding fixedDirectImageComparisonIso and cancelling the inclusion comparisons gives T(E) followed by the inverse of E-prime.

Expand the fixed compact-support comparison for j followed by the identity. Substitute the identity direct-image formula from the preceding step. Naturality of the inverse direct-image identity moves it past the extension comparison and the image of the bounded-below inclusion comparison; cancel the identity isomorphisms. Naturality on the etale side and inverse cancellation of the inclusion comparison leave precisely the inverse extension comparison on K.obj. All calculations take place in the stated bounded-below domain; the first three clauses remain unbounded.

(6) I redid the counit calculation: unit equation, naturality of r at v^e, then the triangle identity; the types check. (7) The Hom chain is the actual pro-etale bijection.
